# Brendon Lai — brendonlai.com | 一个人 × AI，帮中国工业落地东南亚

> Brendon Lai 帮中国工业企业进入东南亚。他的主张是「一个人 × AI = 一支团队」：用 AI 一个人完成过去需要一支团队的工作。这个网站是他的个人 IP 枢纽，持续输出工业出海、AI 自动化与一人公司运营的实战内容。
> Brendon Lai helps Chinese industrial companies enter Southeast Asia. His thesis is "one person × AI = a whole team": using AI, one person does work that used to need a team. This site is his personal IP hub, publishing field notes on industrial expansion, AI automation and one-person-company operations.

## 三个实证 / Three proofs

- 实证 A · 东南亚 0→1：一个人把一间东南亚工业品公司从 0 搭起来，3 套自建系统（产品数据管线、自建 ERP、B2B 产品商城）。
- 实证 B · 跨境出海：把出海最繁琐的合规工序做成工具（SDS 文件生成、进口税务查核、清关与贸易文件）。
- 实证 C · EduStory：和孩子俊宇（Joey）用 AI 拍品格动画，编剧、分镜、动画、配音、剪辑由一个人 + AI 完成。
- Proof A · Southeast Asia 0→1: one person built a Southeast Asian industrial-supply company from zero, with 3 self-built systems (product data pipeline, ERP, B2B product store).
- Proof B · Cross-border: the most tedious go-global compliance work turned into tools (SDS generation, import tax checks, customs & trade documents).
- Proof C · EduStory: character-building cartoons made with his kid Joey using AI — script, storyboard, animation, voice-over and editing by one person + AI.
